operators.name: instance_norm_2d_forward
semantics: Computes InstanceNorm2d over each sample and channel independently: for each (n,c), mean = sum_{h,w} x[n,c,h,w] / (H*W), var = sum_{h,w} (x - mean)^2 / (H*W) (biased variance, no Bessel correction), then output = (x - mean) / sqrt(var + eps).
No affine parameters are applied because affine=False and track_running_stats=False.
Input layout must be contiguous; output shape matches input.

operators.name: relu_forward
semantics: Preserves shape, dtype and device; supports contiguous input.
Calls the custom instance_norm_2d_forward on input x with eps=1e-5.
Output is a tensor of same shape, float32 on cuda.
Calls the custom relu_forward on the instance norm output.
Returns the result from relu_forward as a tensor of shape [128, 3, 512, 512], float32 on cuda.
